text:
Mina: quick heads-up — Hikari-v2 quant bringup is showing some detok/tokenization oddities across CJK and RTL. TL;DR: q4x2 vs float baseline => BLEU down on ja->en and ar->en, plus strange ZWJ/ZWSP handling. posting snippets and repro below. @keiko @javier can you take a look?

Raj: thanks for flagging. do we know if this is purely tokenizer/detok or also model-side generation differences?

Mina: initial signal looks like tokenizer/detok. examples: float baseline detok: "彼は東京に行った。" -> tokens preserved punctuation. q4x2 detok produced an extra space before punctuation and dropped ZWJ around emoji sequences in zh. small sample attached.

Mina: repro commands i used:
```bash
# run a small eval run against Hikari-v2 quant build
python tools/eval_roundtrip.py \
  --model_name=hikari-v2 \
  --quant_profile=q4x2 \
  --samples=200 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ko,ar \
  --detok=default \
  --out=tmp/hikari_q4x2_roundtrip.jsonl
```

Mina: token-level diff example (ja):
```
# baseline detok: "東京 に 行った 。"
# q4x2 detok:  "東京 に 行った  。"  <-- extra space before full-stop
```

Keiko: could be the new tokenization cache invalidation from the recent tokenizer patch (PR #3421). that patch changed how ZWSP is normalized on load. iirc we only applied it to float flows, maybe quant inference path picks up a different serialized vocab?

Javier: i'm triggering a tiny canary run now with explicit tokenizer version pinned (v2026-02-08) and detok mode forced to `legacy`. will paste logs.

deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary/4876543210-1 (hikari-v2 q4x2) — 50 samples across ja/zh/ar/ko. ETA ~ 18m.

Javier: quick log excerpt from canary:
```
INFO: loading tokenizer v2026-02-08
INFO: model checkpoint: hikari-v2-q4x2-2026-03-18
DEBUG: sample[12] locale=ar input="وضعية الاختبار" detok_out="وضعية الاختبار"  # matches baseline
DEBUG: sample[27] locale=ja input="彼は東京に行った。" detok_out="彼は東京に行った  。"  # extra space still present
```

Nora: interesting — if tokenizer version pins don't fix it, maybe the detok routine on the server side applies different normalization for quant kernels (fast-path). can you try forcing `--detok=norm-punct` in the eval to see if punctuation normalization step is the culprit? also please collect raw byte-level token ids for a few failing samples.

Mina: good call. i'll run a small 50-sample run with `--detok=norm-punct` and dump token ids + detoked strings. logging to `tmp/hikari_q4x2_tokenids.jsonl`.

Raj: if this is a detok normalization mismatch we should consider temporary routing rule: for ja/zh/ar routes send quant->float fallback for 95% of traffic until we confirm. not ideal but buys time.

Keiko: i can do a quick bisect of the tokenizer loader serialization change — if the quant runtime is deserializing a different vocabulary shape it would explain ZWJ/ZWSP differences. will bisect PRs since Feb 10.

Mina: plan: 1) run norm-punct eval + token-id dump (Mina, in 30m) 2) Keiko bisects tokenizer load (Keiko) 3) Javier runs canary with explicit `--detok` modes (Javier) 4) decide routing fallback if metrics still bad (Raj). i'll post results here.

Mina: one more note — BLEU delta numbers from the initial 200 sample run were: ja->en -2.1 BLEU, zh->en -1.4 BLEU, ar->en -3.7 BLEU (rtl punctuation heavy subset). absolute numbers small but consistent across samples.

Javier: got it. i'll also run a round using the previous quant build (q4x2-2026-03-10) as a control.

Nora: also add chrF and COMET scores for robustness; BLEU can be sensitive to simple spacing/punct changes.

Mina: thanks all — looping in results when finished. will @mention if we need infra/DL kernel help. :thumbsup:
